player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-iklan {player_id} ({role}) deg wasaɣ {num_rounds} n wassaɣ n uqerru n ifflen.
- Yal wassaɣ, ɛedda [heads] neɣ [tails] (neɣ [h], [t]).
- Ma t-ikli-inek t-iɣda, Massa 0 itarza wassaɣ; neɣer Massa 1 itarza.
ɛedda t-iɣda-inek deg usenfar '[heads]' neɣ '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Amɣid 0 yefka {choice0} ; Amɣid 1 yefka {choice1}. Tegga -> Amɣid 0 yettwassen.
message.round_mismatch: Amɣid 0 yefka {choice0} ; Amɣid 1 yefka {choice1}. Ur d-yegga -> Amɣid 1 yettwassen.
